title: It is so wonderful
body: I love that the AI in this Neurolist app can create such a fantastic morning very detailed routine step by step which will be very easy to follow. It is intuitive and incredibly helpful. Also for each task you can choose the level of how difficult you find it from easy, medium to hard so the AI knows how to create it for you. Harder you find it, more detailed task it creates so it wouldn’t be overwhelming anymore. And it is colourfully cheerful with emojis so not just a plain boring list but visually very attractive. Love it.
author: czbikerchick

title: Begs for a review within seconds
body: Within 5 seconds of opening the app - please leave a review! How? I’ve not even been able to use the app yet let allow judge it. Instantly turned me away before considering the paywall.
author: BertieFlin

title: Review
body: I did not like this program at all. It appeared to be steamrollering me into one particular way of doing things, and seemed to be nagging me almost continuously to upgrade the system to a paid version.
author: Dangerous Crossing

title: Good App With Major Flaw
body: This app is fantastic, but it has one major flaw that I’m hoping will get ironed out—it’s impossible to view or check off subtasks when in the timer mode, meaning you can start a task, but cannot view the subtasks/breakdown developed to make the main task easier/more manageable.
author: JFKdefector

title: Great app
body: Great app, add a task and AI breaks into steps which is really good. My only request would be a widget with the list of tasks
author: Nathen()()()

title: It charges the yearly subscription when you cancel the free trial before expiry.
body: The app was okay, but the fact it charged me for the annual subscription when I cancelled the free trial before the expiry date, makes it terrible. The same happened with their RoutineFlow app.
author: PatchiClaudino
